title: Deferred Interest on PracticePay Patient Financing Plans: Accrual, Payoff Test and Billing
content:
**Scope.** This policy applies to the deferred-interest plans of PracticePay Patient Financing.

**Accrual.** On a deferred-interest plan, interest accrues from the purchase date as simple daily interest at the plan APR on the plan balance excluding fees, and is posted to the deferred interest memo at each statement closing; it is not owed unless the promotional payoff test fails. Deferred interest accrues only while the plan is active.

**The payoff test.** The test passes when the plan balance, less amounts under billing disputes that are still open, is 0.00 at the end of the end date of the promotional period; provider refunds count toward it, and a patient whose dispute was resolved as no error keeps the promotion if the disputed amount is paid within the plan's post-dispute payment days of the resolution.

**If the test passes**, the memo is cleared as forgiven and the plan closes as paid in full within the promotion when its balance is 0.00.

**If the test fails — clause no longer in force.** The clause that, if the test fails, the whole memo (every period since the purchase date, not only the unpaid part) is billed to the balance on the day after the end date of the promotional period and the plan continues at the plan APR for the rest of its term with monthly interest charged from then on, is no longer in force as written; it is superseded by the current terms for a payment reset of a PracticePay plan.

**Billing date.** The billing date is the end date of the promotional period plus 1 calendar day. Deferred interest is billed no earlier than that billing date, and only while the plan is active.

**Other clauses.** A late payment does not cancel the promotion; only the payoff test does. A partial provider refund does not reduce deferred interest already posted to the memo; accrual continues on the lower balance. A full provider refund clears the memo.

## Timing of billing (hypothetical)

| Promotional period ends | Billing date | Billing on the end date itself |
|---|---|---|
| 9 September | 10 September | not allowed; the end date is still inside the promotion |
| 31 October | 1 November | not allowed |

## Payoff test outcomes (hypothetical balances at the end of the end date)

| Plan balance | Amounts under open billing disputes | Balance less those amounts | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | passes |
| 175.00 | 175.00 | 0.00 | passes |
| 175.00 | 100.00 | 75.00 | fails |

superseded_clauses: If it fails, the whole memo - every period since the purchase date, not only the unpaid part - is billed to the balance on the day after promo_end_date and the plan continues at the plan APR for the rest of its term with monthly interest charged from then on.
